generatedProse.practice-connection:
You now have a way of working that will serve you in every module from here. Each time you draw on a reading, quote a source or put an idea in your own words, the habit is at work. Read what each task asks, credit what you use, and let that become second nature.

That same habit carries into professional life. Wherever you build on the work of others, the people who are trusted are the ones who say where their ideas and evidence came from. The practice you have started here is one you will keep long after you graduate.
